name: Para-methoxy-N-ethylamphetamine
summary: para-Methoxyethylamphetamine (PMEA) is a stimulant drug related to PMA. PMEA reputedly produces similar effects to PMA, but is considerably less potent and seems to have slightly less tendency to produce severe hyperthermia, at least at low doses. At higher doses however the side effects and danger of death approach those of PMA itself, and PMEA should still be considered a potentially dangerous drug.

pharmacology.en: Like PMA it releases serotonin and inhibits monoamine oxidase, which is the combination that makes this family dangerous.
pharmacology.zh: 與 PMA 一樣，它會釋放血清素並抑制單胺氧化酶，而正是這種組合讓這個家族相當危險。
pharmacology.zhHans: 与 PMA 一样，它会释放血清素并抑制单胺氧化酶，而正是这种组合让这个家族相当危险。

uses.en: It has no medical use and has appeared as a designer drug, sometimes in tablets sold as ecstasy.
uses.zh: 它沒有醫療用途，曾以設計藥物的形式出現，有時混在以搖頭丸名義販售的錠劑中。
uses.zhHans: 它没有医疗用途，曾以设计药物的形式出现，有时混在以摇头丸名义贩售的锭剂中。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it directly. PMA-type drugs are notorious for causing dangerously high body temperature, a racing heart, seizures and death, partly because effects come on slowly and people take more.
sideEffects.zh: 直接關於它的資料很少。PMA 類藥物以造成危險的高體溫、心跳急促、癲癇發作與死亡而惡名昭彰，部分原因是作用起效緩慢，使人追加使用。
sideEffects.zhHans: 直接关于它的数据很少。PMA 类药物以造成危险的高体温、心跳急促、癫痫发作与死亡而恶名昭彰，部分原因是作用起效缓慢，使人追加使用。

fact.en: It is the N-ethyl version of PMA, which is the same relationship that MDEA has to MDMA. In both pairs the ethyl version is weaker.
fact.zh: 它是 PMA 的 N-乙基版本，就像 MDEA 與 MDMA 的關係一樣。在這兩組中，乙基版本的藥效都較弱。
fact.zhHans: 它是 PMA 的 N-乙基版本，就像 MDEA 与 MDMA 的关系一样。在这两组中，乙基版本的药效都较弱。
